statement: Meta plans to deploy 7 gigawatts of compute in 2026 and roughly double that in 2027, a strong forward-demand signal across accelerators, datacenter capacity, and power.
why: A hyperscaler doubling its deployed compute year over year signals rising capital deployment and forward demand across the AI compute stack.

impact.mechanism: Doubling deployed compute from 7GW to about 14GW implies large incremental purchases of accelerators, datacenter build-out, and power procurement.

evidence.excerpt: deploy 7 gigawatts of compute this year, and double that next.

confidence.basis: Secondary: TechCrunch citing a Reuters-reported internal memo; single-source, capped at medium.
